scope.summary: Implement the region-graft mechanism for third-party anatomy extensions (spec 13.21; REQ-029, DSON-graft-equivalent made Handshake-native): vertex_pairs weld maps plus hidden_polys region replacement with channel-delta projection onto grafts, graft-carried bone splicing, and MT-488 license guarding on all graft imports.
acceptance_criteria: RegionGraft type: vertex_pairs (graft-boundary vertex to base vertex weld map) plus hidden_polys (base faces hidden under the graft); validation requires weld-map completeness and a watertight welded result.
Grafts inherit body channel and corrective deltas via projection (Daz graft-morph-inheritance parity), so third-party anatomy tracks body shape changes automatically.
Graft-carried bones splice into the body skeleton with namespace collision checks and typed failure on conflicts.
MT-488 license guard applies to graft imports fail-closed: license_tag required, prohibited-source (SMPL/.dhdm/Genesis) heuristics enforced.
scope.risk_if_missed: Third-party anatomy extensions are a proven market (the Golden Palace/Dicktator ecosystem exists because Daz outsourced genitals); without a native graft mechanism with license guarding, extensions arrive as unlicensed mesh hacks or not at all (REQ-029).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
